_comment: Product-level roles and permissions. 'permissions' lists extra permissions THIS product adds (resource:action) on top of the factory's core ones. 'default_roles' are the starter roles copied into every new organization; organizations can then create custom roles. The 'owner' role must exist and must hold '*'.

default_roles.name: Owner
default_roles.description: Full control of the organization. Cannot be removed from the last owner.
